neqsim.process.fielddevelopment.wellplanning
Well-planning physics helpers: wellbore thermal profiles, drift-flux tubing hydraulics, gas-condensate inflow, annular pressure build-up and tubing movement, well hydrate-inhibitor treatment, injection-well hydraulics and nodal analysis.
